title: Coordinatewise product input selection
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\Omega$ be a type, and let $u,v\in\Omega^n$. For a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the selected input is the vector whose $i$th coordinate is $u_i$ when $x_i=1$ and $v_i$ otherwise.
